newsitem.title: UK: Charles Taylor valued at 39.4 mln stg in float.
newsitem.headline: Charles Taylor valued at 39.4 mln stg in float.

text.p: Charles Taylor Group Plc said on Friday that trading in its shares was expected to start on October 10 on the London Stock Exchange following a placing that valued it at 39.4 million stg.
The group placed 11,298,890 shares at 135p each in an issue underwritten by de Zoete & Bevan Ltd.

Charles Taylor manages "alternative risk" insurance companies and mutual insurers -- a growing area in which companies or groups of companies set up mutual insurers or captive insurance companies to provide insurance cover.
This results in lower costs as the premiums reflect the risk presented by the participating companies rather than by all the companies in their sector.
Charles Taylor will be the first company with significant alternative risk market exposure to be listed.
"Floating Charles Taylor will provide us with the flexibility to expand our services to the alternative risk market," said chairman and chief executive John Rowe.
"Trading in the first half has been strong and we expect this good progress to continue through the second half."
